title: Many-to-Many Relations
description: Work with many-to-many relations using both implicit and explicit join tables in Prisma.

data.text: Many-to-many relations allow records in Model A to relate to multiple records in Model B, and vice versa. Prisma supports both implicit and explicit many-to-many relations.
In implicit many-to-many relations, Prisma manages the join table automatically. You do not need to define the join table model.

data.title: Implicit Many-to-Many
data.content: Define a many-to-many relation between Post and Category.

data.text: When you need extra fields on the join table, define it explicitly as a model and use two one-to-many relations.

data.title: Explicit Many-to-Many
data.content: Define an explicit join table with additional fields.
